The Perceptual Quality Auditor missed the structural issues because it only looks for noise/blur, not semantic geometry errors. The 'blue smudge' noted by the Router is likely a hallucinated object or artifact. The severity of the key melting is significant enough to impact the overall quality, even if the primary subject (space bar) is recognizable.
